tasks.commitBody:
The agenda gains a month overview: a compact per-month listing —
short weekday, date, title, type badge — behind a two-state
Nimekiri | Kuu segmented control that sits with the filter chips.
The day list stays the default; the choice persists per device in
the #207 preference idiom (sanitized, SSR-safe), and the day list
itself is untouched — the mode is additive, fenced by the existing
agenda suites staying green unmodified.

Scope per the PO ruling on the issue: the overview covers UPCOMING
events only — the commission's own words were forward-looking
('mis sündmused oktoober 2026 tulemas on'), and a merged view
would make past months lie by omission since Recent is a bounded
window. The current month shows its remainder, deliberately. The
day-grouped list, one toggle away, still carries Recent.

Weekday letters are locale keys, not Intl narrow — narrow collides
in three of our four locales (en S/S T/T, lv Sv/Se Pr/Pk, uk
Пн/Пт Ср/Сб; Estonian alone is collision-free) — so collision
locales use two-character strings, marked as refinable copy. Month
headers follow the app language via getLocale, per #251's rule.
Type badges reuse the #211 hue source shared with the chips, so
filtering and the month view speak the same color language — and
the chips filter the month view through the same upstream
mechanism the day list uses, for free.

Per the issue's own acceptance gate: Mihkel reviews this live and
a correction round is budgeted — this delivery aims at the
ruling's letter so that round argues with decisions, not
surprises.

Live gate (Mihkel): open the agenda, tap Kuu — October and
November answer the commissioning question at a glance; tap a
chip, the month shrinks to match; tap Nimekiri, everything is
exactly as it was.
